q.en: Which nuclei together constitute the striatum (the main input stage of the basal ganglia)?
q.uz: Qaysi yadrolar birgalikda striatumni (bazal yadrolarning asosiy kirish qismini) tashkil etadi?

options.en: Caudate nucleus, putamen, and nucleus accumbens
options.uz: Dumli yadro, putamen va accumbens yadrosi

options.en: GPe, GPi, and subthalamic nucleus
options.uz: GPe, GPi va subtalamik yadro

options.en: Thalamus, subthalamic nucleus, and zona incerta
options.uz: Talamus, subtalamik yadro va zona incerta

options.en: Substantia nigra, red nucleus, and VTA
options.uz: Qora modda, qizil yadro va VTA

why.en: The striatum consists of the dorsal striatum (caudate nucleus and putamen, connected across the anterior limb of the internal capsule by grey striatal cell bridges) and the ventral striatum (nucleus accumbens core and shell).
why.uz: Striatum dorsal striatum (dumli yadro va qobiq — putamen; ularni ichki kapsula oldingi oyog'i orqali striatal hujayra ko'prikchalari bog'laydi) hamda ventral striatumdan (accumbens yadrosi o'zagi va qobig'i) iborat.

q.en: Which two structures together form the lens-shaped lentiform (lenticular) nucleus?
q.uz: Qaysi ikki tuzilma birgalikda yasmiqsimon yadroni (nucleus lentiformis) hosil qiladi?

options.en: Putamen (laterally) and globus pallidus (medially)
options.uz: Putamen (lateralda) va rangpar shar (medialda)

options.en: Caudate nucleus (medially) and thalamus (laterally)
options.uz: Dumli yadro (medialda) va talamus (lateralda)

options.en: Claustrum (medially) and insular cortex (laterally)
options.uz: Klaustrum (medialda) va orolcha po'stlog'i (lateralda)

options.en: Subthalamic nucleus (dorsally) and substantia nigra (ventrally)
options.uz: Subtalamik yadro (yuqorida) va qora modda (pastda)

why.en: The lentiform nucleus is a wedge- or lens-shaped grey mass lateral to the internal capsule, composed of the putamen laterally and the globus pallidus (GPe and GPi) medially, separated by the lateral medullary lamina.
why.uz: Yasmiqsimon yadro ichki kapsuladan lateralda joylashgan pona ko'rinishidagi kulrang massa bo'lib, lateralda putamen va medialda rangpar shardan (GPe va GPi) iborat; ularni lateral medullyar plastinka ajratib turadi.

q.en: Which white-matter sheet separates the caudate head and thalamus medially from the lentiform nucleus (putamen and globus pallidus) laterally?
q.uz: Medial tomondagi kaudat boshi va talamusni lateral tomondagi yasmiqsimon yadrodan (putamen va rangpar shardan) ajratib turuvchi oq modda qatlami qaysi?

options.en: Internal capsule
options.uz: Ichki kapsula

options.en: External capsule
options.uz: Tashqi kapsula

options.en: Extreme capsule
options.uz: Eng tashqi kapsula

options.en: Anterior commissure
options.uz: Oldingi komissura

why.en: On axial section (plate B5), the internal capsule (anterior limb, genu, and posterior limb) forms a V-shaped boomerang ('>') opening laterally around the lentiform nucleus: its anterior limb separates the caudate head from the lentiform nucleus, and its posterior limb separates the thalamus from the lentiform nucleus.
why.uz: Aksial kesimda (B5 plastinkasi) ichki kapsula (oldingi oyog'i, tizzasi va orqa oyog'i) lateralga ochilgan bumerang ('>') shaklida ko'rinadi: uning oldingi oyog'i kaudat boshini yasmiqsimon yadrodan, orqa oyog'i esa talamusni yasmiqsimon yadrodan ajratadi.

q.en: Which neuron type accounts for approximately 95 % of all neurons in the striatum (caudate, putamen, and nucleus accumbens), and what is its neurotransmitter?
q.uz: Striatumdagi (kaudat, putamen va accumbens) barcha neyronlarning ~95 % ini qaysi hujayralar tashkil qiladi va ularning neyromediatori nima?

options.en: GABAergic medium spiny neurons (MSNs)
options.uz: GABAergik o'rta tikanli neyronlar (MSN)

options.en: Glutamatergic giant pyramidal (Betz) neurons
options.uz: Glutamatergik gigant piramidal (Bets) neyronlar

options.en: Dopaminergic neuromelanin-containing neurons
options.uz: Dofaminergik neyromelanin saqlovchi neyronlar

options.en: Cholinergic tonically active interneurons
options.uz: Xolinergik tonik faol interneyronlar

why.en: About 95 % of striatal neurons are inhibitory GABAergic medium spiny projection neurons (MSNs): D1/substance P/dynorphin MSNs initiate the direct pathway (→ GPi/SNr), while D2/enkephalin MSNs initiate the indirect pathway (→ GPe). The remaining ~5 % are cholinergic TANs and GABAergic interneurons.
why.uz: Striatum neyronlarining ~95 % ini tormozlovchi GABAergik o'rta tikanli neyronlar (MSN) tashkil etadi: D1/P modda/dinorfin hujayralari to'g'ri yo'lni (→ GPi/SNr), D2/enkefalin hujayralari esa bilvosita yo'lni (→ GPe) boshlaydi.

sources.title: Purves, Neuroscience 2nd ed. — Modulation of movement by the basal ganglia (NCBI Bookshelf)

q.en: Which two nuclei form the principal inhibitory (GABAergic) output stage of the basal ganglia, holding the motor thalamus (VA/VL) under tonic inhibition?
q.uz: Bazal yadrolarning asosiy tormozlovchi (GABAergik) chiqish bo'g'inini hosil qilib, harakat talamusini (VA/VL) doimiy tormozda ushlab turuvchi ikki yadro qaysi?

options.en: Internal globus pallidus (GPi) and substantia nigra pars reticulata (SNr)
options.uz: Ichki rangpar shar (GPi) va qora modda to'rsimon qismi (SNr)

options.en: External globus pallidus (GPe) and subthalamic nucleus (STN)
options.uz: Tashqi rangpar shar (GPe) va subtalamik yadro (STN)

options.en: Dorsal caudate nucleus and sensorimotor putamen (striatum)
options.uz: Dorsal dumli yadro (kaudat) va sensomotor putamen

options.en: Substantia nigra pars compacta (SNc) and ventral tegmental area
options.uz: Qora moddaning zich qismi (SNc) va ventral tegmental soha

why.en: GPi and SNr are the main output nuclei of the basal ganglia. Their GABAergic neurons fire tonically at ~60–100 Hz to inhibit VA/VL thalamus (and superior colliculus/PPN); a movement is released when direct-pathway striatal input briefly pauses GPi/SNr firing.
why.uz: GPi (ichki rangpar shar) va SNr (qora moddaning to'rsimon qismi) bazal yadrolarning asosiy chiqish yadrolari bo'lib, ~60–100 Gs chastotada doimiy GABAergik razryad berib VA/VL talamusni tormozlab turadi; to'g'ri yo'l ularni qisqa muddat to'xtatganda harakatga ruxsat beriladi.

sources.title: Purves, Neuroscience 2nd ed. — Modulation of movement by the basal ganglia (NCBI Bookshelf)

q.en: Which nucleus is the ONLY excitatory (glutamatergic) nucleus intrinsic to the basal ganglia core circuit?
q.uz: Bazal yadrolar ichki zanjiridagi YAGONA qo'zg'atuvchi (glutamatergik) yadro qaysi?

options.en: Subthalamic nucleus (STN)
options.uz: Subtalamik yadro (STN)

options.en: Globus pallidus externus (GPe)
options.uz: Tashqi rangpar shar (GPe)

options.en: Globus pallidus internus (GPi)
options.uz: Ichki rangpar shar (GPi)

options.en: Substantia nigra pars reticulata (SNr)
options.uz: Qora modda to'rsimon qismi (SNr)

why.en: Whereas the striatum, GPe, GPi, and SNr are all GABAergic (inhibitory), the lens-shaped subthalamic nucleus (STN) is glutamatergic and powerfully excites GPi/SNr (and GPe) to brake movement.
why.uz: Striatum, GPe, GPi va SNr barchasi GABAergik (tormozlovchi) bo'lsa, yasmiqsimon subtalamik yadro (STN) bazal yadrolar o'zagidagi yagona glutamatergik (qo'zg'atuvchi) yadro bo'lib, GPi/SNr va GPe ni qo'zg'atadi.

sources.title: Purves, Neuroscience 2nd ed. — Modulation of movement by the basal ganglia (NCBI Bookshelf)

q.en: Which midbrain nucleus supplies dopamine to the dorsal striatum (caudate and putamen) via the nigrostriatal pathway, and degenerates in Parkinson disease?
q.uz: Nigrostriatal yo'l orqali dorsal striatumni (kaudat va putamenni) dofamin bilan ta'minlovchi va Parkinson kasalligida yemiriladigan o'rta miya yadrosi qaysi?

options.en: Substantia nigra pars compacta (SNc)
options.uz: Qora moddaning zich qismi (SNc)

options.en: Substantia nigra pars reticulata
options.uz: Qora moddaning to'rsimon qismi

options.en: Ventral tegmental area (VTA)
options.uz: Ventral tegmental soha (VTA)

options.en: Red nucleus (magnocellular)
options.uz: Qizil yadro (magnotsellyulyar)

why.en: Dopaminergic (neuromelanin-containing) neurons of the substantia nigra pars compacta (SNc) project to the caudate and putamen, exciting D1 direct-pathway MSNs and inhibiting D2 indirect-pathway MSNs. Loss of >60–80 % of SNc neurons produces Parkinson disease.
why.uz: Qora moddaning zich qismi (SNc) dofaminergik (neyromelaninli) neyronlardan iborat bo'lib, kaudat va putamenga nigrostriatal yo'lni beradi (D1 to'g'ri yo'lni qo'zg'atadi, D2 bilvosita yo'lni tormozlaydi). Neyronlarining >60–80 % yo'qolishi Parkinson kasalligini chaqiradi.

sources.title: Purves, Neuroscience 2nd ed. — Modulation of movement by the basal ganglia (NCBI Bookshelf)

q.en: Starting from the lateral edge of the putamen and moving laterally toward the lateral sulcus, what is the correct four-layer sequence ('layer cake') on coronal and axial sections?
q.uz: Koronal va aksial kesimlarda putamenning lateral chetidan tashqariga — lateral egat tomonga qarab ketma-ket joylashgan to'rt qatlam ('qatlamli pirog') tartibi qanday?

options.en: External capsule → claustrum → extreme capsule → insular cortex
options.uz: Tashqi kapsula → klaustrum → eng tashqi kapsula → orolcha po'stlog'i

options.en: Internal capsule → claustrum → external capsule → insular cortex
options.uz: Ichki kapsula → klaustrum → tashqi kapsula → orolcha po'stlog'i

options.en: Extreme capsule → claustrum → external capsule → insular cortex
options.uz: Eng tashqi kapsula → klaustrum → tashqi kapsula → orolcha po'stlog'i

options.en: Lateral medullary lamina → GPe → medial medullary lamina → GPi
options.uz: Lateral medullyar plastinka → GPe → medial medullyar plastinka → GPi

why.en: Lateral to the putamen sit four thin concentric layers in strict order: the white external capsule, the grey sheet of the claustrum, the white extreme capsule, and the cortex of the insula buried in the lateral fissure (plates B1–B5).
why.uz: Putamendan lateral tomonda to'rtta qatlam qat'iy tartibda yotadi: oq tashqi kapsula (capsula externa), yupqa kulrang klaustrum, oq eng tashqi kapsula (capsula extrema) va lateral egat tubidagi orolcha po'stlog'i (insula).

q.en: What is the main functional contrast between the 'direct' and 'indirect' pathways of the basal ganglia?
q.uz: Bazal yadrolarning 'to'g'ri' (direct) va 'bilvosita' (indirect) yo'llari orasidagi asosiy funksional farq nimada?

options.en: Direct (D1) inhibits GPi/SNr to disinhibit thalamus and release movement; indirect (D2) inhibits GPe, activating STN/GPi to suppress movement
options.uz: To'g'ri yo'l (D1) GPi/SNr ni tormozlab talamusni ochadi va harakatni boshlaydi; bilvosita yo'l (D2) GPe ni tormozlab STN/GPi orqali harakatni bostiradi

options.en: Direct (D2) inhibits GPe to activate STN/GPi and suppress movement; indirect (D1) inhibits GPi/SNr directly to disinhibit thalamus and release movement
options.uz: To'g'ri yo'l (D2) GPe ni tormozlab STN/GPi orqali harakatni bostiradi; bilvosita yo'l (D1) GPi/SNr ni tormozlab talamusni ochadi va harakatni boshlaydi

options.en: Direct (D1) excites VA/VL thalamus directly to initiate movement; indirect (D2) projects from the striatum straight to spinal motor neurons
options.uz: To'g'ri yo'l (D1) VA/VL talamusni bevosita qo'zg'atib harakatni boshlaydi; bilvosita yo'l (D2) striatumdan to'g'ridan-to'g'ri orqa miya motoneyronlariga tushadi

options.en: Direct (D1) uses glutamate to excite GPi/SNr during posture; indirect (D2) uses acetylcholine in the STN to inhibit cortical motor planning
options.uz: To'g'ri yo'l (D1) qomatni ushlashda glutamat bilan GPi/SNr ni qo'zg'atadi; bilvosita yo'l (D2) STNda atsetilxolin orqali harakat rejasini tormozlaydi

why.en: Direct-pathway MSNs (D1 receptors) directly inhibit GPi/SNr, pausing their tonic inhibition of VA/VL thalamus ('Go'). Indirect-pathway MSNs (D2 receptors) inhibit GPe, which disinhibits the excitatory STN, driving GPi/SNr to inhibit the thalamus ('No-Go').
why.uz: To'g'ri yo'l (D1 retseptorli MSN'lar) GPi/SNr ni bevosita tormozlab, talamusni tormozdan ozod qiladi va tanlangan harakatga yo'l ochadi. Bilvosita yo'l (D2 retseptorli MSN'lar) GPe ni tormozlaydi, natijada STN tormozdan chiqib GPi/SNr ni qo'zg'atadi va istalmagan harakatni bostiradi.

sources.title: Purves, Neuroscience 2nd ed. — Modulation of movement by the basal ganglia (NCBI Bookshelf)

q.en: Which dramatic movement disorder is classically caused by a small lacunar stroke of the subthalamic nucleus (STN)?
q.uz: Subtalamik yadroning (STN) kichik lakunar infarkti klassik ravishda qaysi harakat buzilishini keltirib chiqaradi?

options.en: Contralateral hemiballismus (violent flinging of the opposite limbs)
options.uz: Qarama-qarshi gemiballizm (qarama-qarshi oyoq-qo'lning keskin otilishi)

options.en: Ipsilateral resting pill-rolling tremor, rigidity, and bradykinesia
options.uz: O'sha tomonda tinch holat tremori, mushak rigidligi va bradikineziya

options.en: Contralateral spastic hemiparesis with hyperreflexia and Babinski sign
options.uz: Qarama-qarshi spastik gemiparez, giperrefleksiya va Babinski belgisi

options.en: Ipsilateral intention tremor, dysmetria, and scanning dysarthria
options.uz: O'sha tomonda intension tremor, dismetriya va skandirlangan nutq

why.en: Loss of the excitatory glutamatergic drive from the STN to the ipsilateral GPi drops GPi inhibitory output, releasing the motor thalamus (VA/VL) and producing violent, involuntary flinging movements of the contralateral limbs (hemiballismus).
why.uz: STN zararlanganda uning GPi ga beradigan qo'zg'atuvchi (glutamatergik) ta'siri yo'qoladi; natijada GPi tormozi susayib, harakat talamusi haddan tashqari faollashadi va qarama-qarshi oyoq-qo'llarda keskin otilib ketuvchi harakatlar — gemiballizm paydo bo'ladi.

sources.title: Purves, Neuroscience 2nd ed. — Modulation of movement by the basal ganglia (NCBI Bookshelf)

q.en: By which two white-matter tracts do pallidothalamic fibres leave the internal segment of the globus pallidus (GPi) to converge in Forel field H (prerubral field) and ascend as the thalamic fasciculus (H1) to VA/VLa thalamus?
q.uz: Ichki rangpar shardan (GPi) chiquvchi pallidotalamik tolalar qaysi ikki yo'l orqali Forel H maydonida birlashib, talamik tutam (H1) sifatida VA/VLa talamusga ko'tariladi?

options.en: Ansa lenticularis and lenticular fasciculus (Forel field H2)
options.uz: Ansa lenticularis va yasmiqsimon tutam (Forel H2 maydoni)

options.en: Stria terminalis and stria medullaris thalami (epithalamic bundle)
options.uz: Stria terminalis va stria medullaris thalami (epitalamik tutam)

options.en: Mammillothalamic tract and central tegmental tract (brainstem bundle)
options.uz: Mamillotalamik trakt va markaziy tegmental trakt (ustun tutami)

options.en: Subthalamic fasciculus and superior cerebellar peduncle (dentatothalamic)
options.uz: Subtalamik tutam va yuqori miyacha oyoqchasi (dentatotalamik yo'l)

why.en: On plates B3 and B4, GPi outflow takes two paths: ventral/lateral fibres loop under the internal capsule as the ansa lenticularis, while dorsal fibres pierce the capsule as the lenticular fasciculus (Forel field H2, between zona incerta above and STN below). Both meet in the prerubral field (H) and turn dorsolaterally as the thalamic fasciculus (H1, joined by dentatothalamic fibres) into VA/VL thalamus.
why.uz: B3 va B4 plastinkalarida GPi chiqishi ikki yo'l bilan ketadi: ventral qismdan ansa lenticularis ichki kapsula ostidan aylanib o'tadi, dorsal qismdan esa yasmiqsimon tutam (Forel H2 maydoni) kapsulani teshib, zona incerta va STN orasidan o'tadi. Ikkalasi Forel H maydonida uchrashib, talamik tutam (H1) bo'lib VA/VL talamusga ko'tariladi.

q.en: On the coronal subthalamic plate (B4, MNI y = −13 mm, 'the DBS level'), how are the four layers of the subthalamus stacked from dorsal (just beneath the thalamus) to ventral (above the substantia nigra and cerebral peduncle)?
q.uz: Subtalamik koronal kesimda (B4 plastinkasi, MNI y = −13 mm — 'DBS darajasi') talamus ostidan pastga — miya oyoqchasi va qora moddagacha to'rtta qavat qanday 'sendvich' tartibida taxlangan?

options.en: Thalamic fasciculus (H1) → zona incerta → lenticular fasciculus (H2) → subthalamic nucleus
options.uz: Talamik tutam (H1) → zona incerta → yasmiqsimon tutam (H2) → subtalamik yadro

options.en: Lenticular fasciculus (H2) → zona incerta → thalamic fasciculus (H1) → subthalamic nucleus
options.uz: Yasmiqsimon tutam (H2) → zona incerta → talamik tutam (H1) → subtalamik yadro

options.en: Subthalamic nucleus → thalamic fasciculus (H1) → zona incerta → lenticular fasciculus (H2)
options.uz: Subtalamik yadro → talamik tutam (H1) → zona incerta → yasmiqsimon tutam (H2)

options.en: Zona incerta → subthalamic nucleus → thalamic fasciculus (H1) → lenticular fasciculus (H2)
options.uz: Zona incerta → subtalamik yadro → talamik tutam (H1) → yasmiqsimon tutam (H2)

why.en: At the subthalamic level (plate B4), directly beneath the motor thalamus (VL) from dorsal to ventral lie: (1) thalamic fasciculus (Forel H1), (2) zona incerta, (3) lenticular fasciculus (Forel H2), and (4) the lens-shaped subthalamic nucleus (STN) resting on the dorsomedial crus cerebri above the substantia nigra (SNc over SNr).
why.uz: B4 plastinkasida harakat talamusi (VL) ostida yuqoridan pastga 'sendvich' kabi joylashgan: (1) talamik tutam (H1), (2) zona incerta, (3) yasmiqsimon tutam (H2) va (4) miya oyoqchasi ustidagi subtalamik yadro (STN); STN ostida esa qora modda (SNc va SNr) yotadi.

q.en: What is the 'hyperdirect pathway' of the basal ganglia (Nambu et al. 2002), and what is its physiological role?
q.uz: Bazal yadrolarning 'giperto'g'ri yo'li' (hyperdirect pathway — Nambu va b., 2002) qayerdan qayerga boradi va qanday vazifani bajaradi?

options.en: Monosynaptic glutamatergic projection from motor/prefrontal cortex to STN, exciting GPi/SNr as a fast global brake
options.uz: Harakat/prefrontal po'stloqdan STNga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri glutamatergik yo'l; GPi/SNr ni tez qo'zg'atib global tormoz beradi

options.en: Monosynaptic GABAergic projection from dorsal striatum to VA/VL thalamus, bypassing GPi to accelerate action initiation
options.uz: Dorsal striatumdan GPi ni chetlab VA/VL talamusga boruvchi GABAergik yo'l; ixtiyoriy harakatni boshlashni tezlashtiradi

options.en: Direct dopaminergic projection from SNc to motor cortex M1, bypassing the striatum to potentiate corticospinal output
options.uz: SNc dan striatumni chetlab M1 harakat po'stlog'iga boruvchi dofaminergik yo'l; kortikospinal chiqishni kuchaytiradi

options.en: Direct glutamatergic projection from GPe to motor thalamus, bypassing STN and GPi to sustain ongoing rhythmic movements
options.uz: GPe dan STN va GPi ni chetlab harakat talamusiga boruvchi glutamatergik yo'l; davom etayotgan ritmik harakatlarni ushlaydi

why.en: Nambu et al. (2002) demonstrated that corticosubthalamic axons (from M1, SMA, pre-SMA, and right IFG) bypass the striatum to excite the STN directly; because conduction is faster than through the striatum, this hyperdirect pathway briefly suppresses competing motor programs or halts an action globally.
why.uz: Nambu va hammualliflar (2002) ko'rsatganidek, M1, SMA va IFG po'stlog'idan chiquvchi tolalar striatumni chetlab o'tib, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri STN ni qo'zg'atadi; bu 'giperto'g'ri yo'l' GPi/SNr orqali talamusni eng tez tormozlaydi va harakatni darhol to'xtatuvchi 'tormoz' bo'lib xizmat qiladi.

sources.title: Nambu, Tokuno & Takada 2002, Neurosci Res — Functional significance of the cortico-subthalamo-pallidal 'hyperdirect' pathway

q.en: How do the nucleus accumbens core (AcbL) and shell (AcbM) differ in their anatomical connections and roles in reward and addiction (plate B1)?
q.uz: Accumbens yadrosining o'zagi (core, AcbL) va qobig'i (shell, AcbM) anatomik bog'lanishlari hamda mukofot va giyohvandlikdagi roli bo'yicha qanday farq qiladi (B1 plastinkasi)?

options.en: Core links OFC/ACC and ventral pallidum → MD thalamus for cue-driven approach; shell links LHA/VTA/VP for hedonic hotspots and drug dopamine surges
options.uz: O'zak (core) OFC/ACC va VP → MD talamus orqali maqsadli harakatni; qobiq (shell) LHA/VTA/VP orqali hedonik nuqtalar va dorilarga dofamin otilishini boshqaradi

options.en: Core links LHA and VTA for visceral hedonic hotspots and drug surges; shell links dorsolateral prefrontal cortex and GPi for motor habit execution
options.uz: O'zak (core) LHA va VTA orqali visseral hedonik nuqtalar hamda dorilarga dofamin javobini; qobiq (shell) DLPFC va GPi orqali harakat odatlarini boshqaradi

options.en: Core projects directly via the fornix to mammillary bodies for spatial memory; shell projects via the internal capsule to primary motor cortex M1
options.uz: O'zak (core) fornix orqali so'rg'ichsimon tanalarga fazoviy xotira uchun; qobiq (shell) ichki kapsula orqali birlamchi harakat po'stlog'i M1 ga proyeksiya beradi

options.en: Core receives exclusively serotonergic raphe input for sleep-wake transitions; shell receives exclusively noradrenergic locus coeruleus input for arousal
options.uz: O'zak (core) uyqu-uyg'oqlik uchun faqat chok yadrolari serotoninini; qobiq (shell) esa hushyorlik uchun faqat ko'k dog' noradrenalinini qabul qiladi

why.en: On plate B1, the nucleus accumbens has a lateral core (AcbL, continuous with caudate/putamen, projecting via VP to MD thalamus for Pavlovian cue-driven action) and a medial/ventral crescentic shell (AcbM, projecting to LHA, VTA, and VP, containing opioid/endocannabinoid hedonic hotspots and exhibiting the largest dopamine surge to drugs of abuse).
why.uz: B1 plastinkasida accumbens yadrosi lateral o'zak (core — AcbL: VP → MD talamus orqali signalga javoban maqsadli harakatni boshqaradi) hamda medial/ventral o'roqsimon qobiqqa (shell — AcbM: LHA, VTA va VP bilan bog'langan, hedonik 'yoqtirish' nuqtalari va giyohvand moddalarga eng kuchli dofamin otilishi joyi) bo'linadi.

sources.title: Haber & Knutson 2010, Neuropsychopharmacology — The reward circuit: linking primate anatomy and human imaging

q.en: On the axial plate of the internal capsule (B5, MNI z = +4 mm), what passes through each of its four parts from anterior to posterior (anterior limb, genu, posterior limb, and retrolenticular part)?
q.uz: Ichki kapsulaning aksial kesimida (B5 plastinkasi, MNI z = +4 mm) oldindan orqaga uning to'rt qismidan (oldingi oyoq, tizza, orqa oyoq va retrolentikulyar qism) qaysi tolalar o'tadi?

options.en: Anterior limb: frontopontine/anterior thalamic; Genu: corticobulbar; Posterior limb: corticospinal/sensory; Retrolenticular: optic radiation
options.uz: Oldingi oyoq: frontopontin/oldingi talamik; Tizza: kortikobulbar; Orqa oyoq: kortikospinal/sezgi; Retrolentikulyar: ko'rish radiatsiyasi

options.en: Anterior limb: corticobulbar; Genu: frontopontine/anterior thalamic; Posterior limb: optic radiation; Retrolenticular: corticospinal/sensory
options.uz: Oldingi oyoq: kortikobulbar; Tizza: frontopontin/oldingi talamik; Orqa oyoq: ko'rish radiatsiyasi; Retrolentikulyar: kortikospinal/sezgi

options.en: Anterior limb: corticospinal (arm/leg); Genu: superior thalamic sensory; Posterior limb: corticobulbar; Retrolenticular: frontopontine fibres
options.uz: Oldingi oyoq: kortikospinal (qo'l/oyoq); Tizza: yuqori talamik sezgi; Orqa oyoq: kortikobulbar; Retrolentikulyar: frontopontin tolalar

options.en: Anterior limb: optic/auditory radiations; Genu: corticospinal (leg); Posterior limb: frontopontine; Retrolenticular: anterior thalamic radiation
options.uz: Oldingi oyoq: ko'rish/eshitish radiatsiyasi; Tizza: kortikospinal (oyoq); Orqa oyoq: frontopontin; Retrolentikulyar: oldingi talamik radiatsiya

why.en: From front to back in the internal capsule (plate B5): the anterior limb (between caudate head and lentiform) carries frontopontine and thalamo-prefrontal fibres; the genu (at the foramen of Monro) carries corticobulbar fibres; the posterior limb (between thalamus and lentiform) carries corticospinal (arm → trunk → leg) and thalamocortical somatosensory fibres; the retrolenticular (and sublenticular) parts carry the optic (and auditory) radiations.
why.uz: B5 aksial plastinkasida ichki kapsula qismlari: oldingi oyoq — frontopontin va oldingi talamik (MD → prefrontal) radiatsiya; tizza — kortikobulbar tolalar (yuz, til, halqum); orqa oyoq — kortikospinal (qo'l oldinda → oyoq orqada) va yuqori talamik sezgi radiatsiyasi (VPL/VPM → S1); retrolentikulyar qism — ko'rish radiatsiyasi (LGN → V1).

q.en: Which subregion of the striatum loses dopaminergic innervation earliest in Parkinson disease (producing the 'comma → full stop' transition on DaT-SPECT imaging)?
q.uz: Parkinson kasalligida striatumning qaysi qismida dofamin eng birinchi yo'qoladi (DaT-SPECT tasvirida 'vergul → nuqta' o'zgarishini beradi)?

options.en: Dorsolateral (postcommissural) putamen — sensorimotor striatum
options.uz: Dorsolateral (postkommissural) putamen — sensomotor striatum

options.en: Anteromedial caudate head — associative prefrontal striatum
options.uz: Anteromedial kaudat boshi — assotsiativ prefrontal striatum

options.en: Medial shell of nucleus accumbens — limbic ventral striatum
options.uz: Accumbens yadrosi medial qobig'i — limbik ventral striatum

options.en: Ventrolateral caudate tail — occipitotemporal visual striatum
options.uz: Ventrolateral kaudat dumi — ensa-chakka ko'rish striatumi

why.en: In Parkinson disease, ventrolateral SNc neurons projecting to the dorsolateral (postcommissural, sensorimotor) putamen degenerate first. On DaT-SPECT, normal comma-shaped striatal uptake loses its posterior tail (putamen), leaving a round 'full stop' over the relatively preserved caudate head.
why.uz: Parkinson kasalligida SNc ning ventrolateral qismi eng avval yemirilib, dofamin birinchi bo'lib sensomotor striatumda — dorsolateral (komissuradan keyingi) putamenda yo'qoladi; shu sababli DaT-SPECTda normal 'vergul' shakli kaudat boshidagi 'nuqta'ga aylanib qoladi.

q.en: In Huntington disease, which striatal neuron population degenerates earliest to produce the initial hyperkinetic chorea, and what characteristic ventricular shape appears on coronal/axial MRI (plate B1)?
q.uz: Huntington kasalligida dastlabki giperkinetik xoreyani keltirib chiqaruvchi qaysi striatal neyronlar eng avval nobud bo'ladi va MRTda (B1 plastinkasi) frontal shoxlar qanday shakl oladi?

options.en: Indirect-pathway D2/enkephalin MSNs of the caudate head die first, creating flattened 'boxcar' frontal horns
options.uz: Kaudat boshidagi bilvosita D2/enkefalin MSN'lari birinchi nobud bo'lib, 'quti' (boxcar) frontal shoxlar hosil qiladi

options.en: Direct-pathway D1/substance P MSNs of the posterior putamen die first, creating narrow slit-like frontal horns
options.uz: Orqa putamendagi to'g'ri D1/P modda MSN'lari birinchi nobud bo'lib, tor tirqishsimon frontal shoxlar hosil qiladi

options.en: Cholinergic striatal interneurons of nucleus accumbens die first, creating asymmetrically enlarged temporal horns
options.uz: Accumbens yadrosining xolinergik interneyronlari birinchi nobud bo'lib, kengaygan chakka shoxlarini hosil qiladi

options.en: Dopaminergic SNc neurons and pallidal border cells die first, creating pronounced colpocephaly of occipital horns
options.uz: SNc dofaminergik neyronlari va pallidal chegara hujayralari birinchi nobud bo'lib, orqa shox kolpotsefaliyasini beradi

why.en: In Huntington disease (HTT CAG repeat expansion), indirect-pathway (D2/enkephalin) MSNs of the caudate head die earliest: GPe is over-inhibited, STN is under-driven, and GPi inhibitory output falls, producing chorea (later D1 MSN loss leads to rigidity/akinesia). Atrophy of the caudate head abolishes its convex bulge into the frontal horn, creating 'boxcar' ventricles with an increased bicaudate ratio (plate B1).
why.uz: Huntington kasalligida kaudat boshidagi bilvosita yo'l (D2/enkefalin) MSN'lari eng avval nobud bo'ladi → GPe ortiqcha tormozlanadi → STN kam qo'zg'aladi → GPi chiqishi pasayib xoreya yuzaga keladi. Kaudat boshi atrofiyasi tufayli MRTda (B1 plastinkasi) frontal shoxlar 'quti' (boxcar) shaklini oladi.

sources.title: Purves, Neuroscience 2nd ed. — Modulation of movement by the basal ganglia (NCBI Bookshelf)

q.en: How are the striosome (patch) and matrix compartments of the striatum organized, and what are the two functional cell classes of the external globus pallidus (GPe)?
q.uz: Striatumning striosoma (yamoq) va matriks bo'lmalari qanday tuzilgan hamda tashqi rangpar sharning (GPe) ikki xil hujayra sinfi qaysilar?

options.en: Striosomes project to SNc and matrix projects to GPe/GPi/SNr; GPe has prototypic (→ STN/GPi) and arkypallidal (→ striatum) cells
options.uz: Striosomalar SNc ga, matriks GPe/GPi/SNr ga boradi; GPe da prototipik (→ STN/GPi) va arkipallidal (→ striatum) hujayralar bor

options.en: Striosomes project to GPi/SNr and matrix projects exclusively to SNc; GPe contains direct (D1+) and indirect (D2+) spiny neurons
options.uz: Striosomalar GPi/SNr ga, matriks esa faqat SNc ga boradi; GPe da to'g'ri (D1+) va bilvosita (D2+) o'rta tikanli neyronlar bor

options.en: Striosomes relay motor cortex to STN and matrix relays thalamus to M1; GPe has glutamatergic relay and cholinergic interneurons
options.uz: Striosomalar harakat po'stlog'ini STNga, matriks talamusni M1 ga bog'laydi; GPe da glutamatergik va xolinergik hujayralar bor

options.en: Striosomes form internal capsule fascicles and matrix holds glial syncytia; GPe has dopaminergic (→ putamen) and serotonergic cells
options.uz: Striosomalar ichki kapsula tutamlarini, matriks glia qatlamini tuzadi; GPe da dofaminergik (→ putamen) va serotoninergik hujayralar bor

why.en: Striatal MSNs are organized into limbic-recipient striosomes (projecting to SNc) embedded in a sensorimotor/associative matrix (projecting to GPe/GPi/SNr). In GPe, roughly two-thirds of neurons are parvalbumin-positive prototypic cells projecting to STN and GPi/SNr, whereas FoxP2-positive arkypallidal cells project exclusively back to the striatum to cancel evolving actions (Mallet 2012/2016).
why.uz: Striatum MSN'lari matriks ichidagi striosomalardan (limbik kirish olib SNc ga boradi; matriks esa sensomotor/assotsiativ kirish olib GPe/GPi/SNr ga boradi) iborat. GPe ichida esa ikki xil GABAergik hujayra bor: prototipik (≈2/3, parvalbumin+, STN va chiqish yadrolariga boradi) hamda arkipallidal (FoxP2+, faqat striatumga qaytib 'to'xta' signalini beradi).

q.en: Which perforating arteries supply (1) the anteromedial caudate head, anterior limb of the internal capsule, and nucleus accumbens versus (2) the putamen and lateral globus pallidus (the commonest site of hypertensive intracerebral haemorrhage)?
q.uz: Qaysi perforant arteriyalar (1) kaudat boshining anteromedial qismi, ichki kapsula oldingi oyog'i va accumbens yadrosini, (2) putamen va tashqi rangpar sharni (gipertonik qon quyilishining eng ko'p joyini) qon bilan ta'minlaydi?

options.en: (1) Recurrent artery of Heubner (ACA); (2) Lateral lenticulostriate arteries (M1 MCA)
options.uz: (1) Heubner qaytuvchi arteriyasi (ACA); (2) Lateral lentikulostriar arteriyalar (M1 MCA)

options.en: (1) Lateral lenticulostriate arteries (M1 MCA); (2) Recurrent artery of Heubner (ACA)
options.uz: (1) Lateral lentikulostriar arteriyalar (M1 MCA); (2) Heubner qaytuvchi arteriyasi (ACA)

options.en: (1) Anterior choroidal artery (ICA); (2) Thalamoperforating arteries (P1 PCA segment)
options.uz: (1) Oldingi xorioidal arteriya (ICA); (2) Talamoperforant arteriyalar (P1 PCA segmenti)

options.en: (1) Thalamogeniculate arteries (P2 PCA); (2) Paramedian pontine perforators (basilar)
options.uz: (1) Talamogenikulyar arteriyalar (P2 PCA); (2) Paramedian ko'prik perforantlari (bazilyar)

why.en: On plates B1–B2, the recurrent artery of Heubner (from A1/A2 ACA, alongside medial lenticulostriate branches) supplies the anteromedial caudate head, anterior limb, and nucleus accumbens (infarction causes abulia/apathy rather than weakness). The lateral lenticulostriate perforators (from M1 MCA) supply the putamen, GPe, and dorsal internal capsule, and are the site of ~35 % of hypertensive intracerebral haemorrhages.
why.uz: Heubner qaytuvchi arteriyasi (ACA A1/A2 tutashuvidan) kaudat boshining anteromedial qismi, oldingi oyoq va accumbensni ta'minlaydi (infarkti kuchsizlik emas, abuliya va apatiya beradi). O'rta miya arteriyasi (M1) dan chiquvchi lateral lentikulostriar arteriyalar esa putamen, GPe va kapsulaning dorsal qismini ta'minlaydi hamda gipertonik miya ichi qon quyilishining (~35 %) eng ko'p uchraydigan joyidir.

q.en: Why is the globus pallidus selectively damaged in carbon monoxide (CO) poisoning or global hypoxia, and which metabolic/toxic disorders produce symmetric basal ganglia lesions in the putamen or globus pallidus?
q.uz: Nima uchun is gazi (CO) bilan zaharlanishda yoki gipoksiyada rangpar shar (globus pallidus) tanlab nekrozga uchraydi, shuningdek putamen va pallidum yana qaysi metabolik/toksik kasalliklarda simmetrik zararlanadi?

options.en: High iron content and border-zone supply make GP vulnerable to CO/hypoxia and manganese; Wilson disease and methanol target the putamen
options.uz: Yuqori temir va chegara qon ta'minoti GP ni CO/gipoksiya va marganetsga sezgir qiladi; Vilson kasalligi va metanol putamenni zararlaydi

options.en: High dopamine uptake and venous drainage make GP vulnerable to methanol and Wilson disease; CO poisoning and kernicterus target the putamen
options.uz: Yuqori dofamin va venoz oqim GP ni metanol hamda Vilson kasalligiga sezgir qiladi; CO zaharlanishi va yadro sariqligi putamenni zararlaydi

options.en: Lack of blood-brain barrier makes GP vulnerable to thiamine deficiency and osmotic stress; CO poisoning selectively targets the claustrum
options.uz: Gematotsefalik to'siq yo'qligi GP ni tiamin tanqisligi va osmotik stressga sezgir qiladi; CO zaharlanishi esa faqat klaustrumni zararlaydi

options.en: High cholinergic density makes GP vulnerable to copper overload and hypoglycemia; manganese toxicity selectively targets the caudate tail
options.uz: Yuqori xolinergik zichlik GP ni mis ortiqchaligi va gipoglikemiyaga sezgir qiladi; marganets zaharlanishi esa faqat kaudat dumini zararlaydi

why.en: On plates B2 and B3, the globus pallidus is iron-rich and sits at an arterial border zone (lenticulostriate vs anterior choroidal): CO poisoning/hypoxia causes bilateral pallidal T2 hyperintensity and necrosis; unconjugated bilirubin (kernicterus) and manganese (liver failure/TPN) also target GP. The putamen is classically damaged in Wilson disease (copper), methanol poisoning (formic acid), and mitochondrial Leigh disease.
why.uz: B2 va B3 plastinkalarida rangpar shar temirga boy va arterial chegara zonasida yotadi: is gazi (CO) va gipoksiya ikki tomonlama pallidar nekroz va kechikkan parkinsonizm beradi; yadro sariqligi (bilirubin) va marganets ham GP ni zararlaydi. Putamen esa Vilson kasalligi (mis), metanol va gipoksiyada tanlab shikastlanadi.

q.en: During stereotactic deep-brain stimulation (DBS) implantation into the left subthalamic nucleus (STN) at coronal level B4 (MNI y = −13 mm, ~12 mm lateral, 2–3 mm posterior, 4–5 mm inferior to the mid-commissural point), the microelectrode descends through a quiet zone into a 4–5 mm band of dense 20–50 Hz irregular firing with prominent beta-band (13–30 Hz) local field potentials, and then enters regular ~70 Hz tonic firing below. Test stimulation at the target causes: (a) right facial/arm tonic contractions if the lead is too lateral, (b) ipsilateral eye adduction weakness/diplopia if too medial, (c) right-sided tingling paraesthesias if too posterior, or (d) acute euphoria/hypomania if placed in the ventromedial tip. Map the microelectrode track and the four boundary structures:
q.uz: Koronal B4 darajasida (MNI y = −13 mm) chap subtalamik yadroga (STN) DBS elektrodi kiritilmoqda. Mikroelektrod yuqoridan tushishda avval sokin qatlamdan o'tib, 20–50 Gs noto'g'ri razryadli va kuchli beta-to'lqinli (13–30 Gs) LFP beruvchi yadroga, undan pastda esa muntazam ~70 Gs tonik razryad beruvchi yadroga kirdi. Sinov stimulyatsiyasida elektrod: (a) juda lateral bo'lsa o'ng yuz/qo'l tortishishi, (b) juda medial bo'lsa ko'z og'ishi va diplopiya, (c) juda orqada bo'lsa o'ng tomonda uvishish (paresteziya), (d) medial uchida bo'lsa gipomaniya/impulsivlik berdi. Mikroelektrod yo'li va to'rtta chegara tuzilmasini aniqlang:

options.en: Track: zona incerta → dorsolateral STN → SNr; Neighbours: (a) internal capsule, (b) CN III fibres, (c) medial lemniscus, (d) limbic STN tip
options.uz: Yo'l: zona incerta → dorsolateral STN → SNr; Qo'shnilar: (a) ichki kapsula, (b) III nerv tolalari, (c) medial lemnisk, (d) STN limbik uchi

options.en: Track: thalamic fasciculus → VLa thalamus → zona incerta; Neighbours: (a) optic tract, (b) fornix column, (c) pulvinar, (d) mammillary body
options.uz: Yo'l: talamik tutam → VLa talamus → zona incerta; Qo'shnilar: (a) ko'rish trakti, (b) fornix ustuni, (c) pulvinar, (d) so'rg'ichsimon tana

options.en: Track: GPe → medial medullary lamina → GPi; Neighbours: (a) external capsule, (b) internal capsule, (c) optic tract, (d) nucleus basalis
options.uz: Yo'l: GPe → medial plastinka → GPi; Qo'shnilar: (a) tashqi kapsula, (b) ichki kapsula, (c) ko'rish trakti, (d) bazal Meynert yadrosi

options.en: Track: dorsolateral STN → zona incerta → VPL thalamus; Neighbours: (a) medial lemniscus, (b) internal capsule, (c) CN III fibres, (d) red nucleus
options.uz: Yo'l: dorsolateral STN → zona incerta → VPL talamus; Qo'shnilar: (a) medial lemnisk, (b) ichki kapsula, (c) III nerv tolalari, (d) qizil yadro

why.en: On plate B4, a dorsal-to-ventral STN DBS trajectory passes through the quiet zona incerta (and H2) into the dorsolateral sensorimotor STN (20–50 Hz bursty firing + pathological beta LFPs used for adaptive DBS), and below into the GABAergic SNr (~70 Hz regular firing). Current spread maps directly onto the anatomy: lateral = internal capsule (corticospinal contractions), medial = oculomotor (CN III) fibres/red nucleus, posterior = medial lemniscus (paraesthesias), and the medial tip of the tripartite STN = limbic territory (hypomania/impulsivity).
why.uz: B4 plastinkasida STN DBS yo'li yuqoridan pastga sokin zona incertadan o'tib, dorsolateral sensomotor STNga (20–50 Gs razryad va adaptiv DBS uchun ishlatiladigan beta LFP) va uning ostidagi SNr ga (~70 Gs muntazam razryad) tushadi. Nojo'ya ta'sirlar qo'shnilarga aniq mos keladi: lateralda — ichki kapsula (mushak qisqarishi), medialda — III nerv tolalari (diplopiya), orqada — medial lemnisk (paresteziya) va uch qismli STNning medial uchida — limbik zona (gipomaniya).

sources.title: Alexander, DeLong & Strick 1986, Annu Rev Neurosci — Parallel organization of functionally segregated circuits linking basal ganglia and cortex

q.en: During posteroventral globus pallidus internus (GPi) DBS surgery for generalized dystonia or levodopa-induced dyskinesia (coronal plate B3, MNI y = −6 mm), the microelectrode passes from a region of ~60–80 Hz tonic firing with characteristic pauses, across a thin white lamina with border cells, into tonic high-frequency (60–100 Hz) firing. When the surgeon tests stimulation at the deepest contact, the patient reports seeing flashes of light (phosphenes) in the contralateral visual field; when stimulation is shifted too far medially, contralateral limb contractions occur. Which structures explain the recording transition, the phosphenes, and the motor contractions?
q.uz: Generalizatsiyalangan distoniya yoki diskineziya uchun posteroventral GPi DBS operatsiyasida (B3 plastinkasi, MNI y = −6 mm) mikroelektrod pauzali ~60–80 Gs razryad beruvchi yadrodan yupqa oq plastinka orqali 60–100 Gs tonik razryad beruvchi yadroga o'tdi. Eng pastki kontaktda sinov stimulyatsiyasi berilganda bemor qarama-qarshi ko'rish maydonida yorug'lik chaqnashlarini (fosfenlarni) ko'rdi; tok medialga siljitilganda esa qarama-qarshi oyoq-qo'l qisqarishi yuz berdi. Bu belgilarni qaysi tuzilmalar izohlaydi?

options.en: Transition: GPe → medial medullary lamina → GPi; Phosphenes: optic tract ventrally; Contractions: internal capsule posterior limb medially
options.uz: O'tish: GPe → medial medullyar plastinka → GPi; Fosfenlar: ostidagi ko'rish trakti; Qisqarish: medialdagi ichki kapsula orqa oyog'i

options.en: Transition: putamen → lateral medullary lamina → GPe; Phosphenes: lateral geniculate nucleus; Contractions: corticobulbar genu anteriorly
options.uz: O'tish: putamen → lateral medullyar plastinka → GPe; Fosfenlar: lateral tizzasimon yadro; Qisqarish: oldindagi kortikobulbar tizza

options.en: Transition: zona incerta → lenticular fasciculus → STN; Phosphenes: optic radiation posteriorly; Contractions: cerebral peduncle ventrally
options.uz: O'tish: zona incerta → yasmiqsimon tutam → STN; Fosfenlar: orqadagi ko'rish radiatsiyasi; Qisqarish: ventral miya oyoqchasi tolalari

options.en: Transition: VPL → internal medullary lamina → VLa thalamus; Phosphenes: superior colliculus; Contractions: red nucleus rubral outflow
options.uz: O'tish: VPL → ichki medullyar plastinka → VLa talamus; Fosfenlar: yuqori do'nglik; Qisqarish: qizil yadro rubral chiqish tolalari

why.en: On plate B3, the electrode trajectory into posteroventral GPi crosses from GPe (tonic ~60–80 Hz with pauses) through the medial medullary lamina (border cells) into GPi (tonic 60–100 Hz). Posteroventral GPi sits directly above the optic tract (so too-deep stimulation evokes visual phosphenes) and ~3–4 mm lateral to the posterior limb of the internal capsule (so too-medial stimulation drives corticospinal contractions).
why.uz: B3 plastinkasida ko'rinib turganidek, mikroelektrod GPe dan (pauzali ~60–80 Gs) medial medullyar plastinka orqali GPi ga (tonik 60–100 Gs) o'tadi. Posteroventral GPi bevosita ko'rish trakti (tractus opticus) ustida yotadi — elektrod juda chuqur ketsa fosfenlar paydo bo'ladi; medialda esa ichki kapsulaning orqa oyog'i joylashgan (kapsula qisqarishi = juda medial).

q.en: A 61-year-old woman with hypertension presents with sudden-onset dense right-sided weakness affecting the face (lower half), arm, and leg equally, with completely normal touch, vibration, pain, and temperature sensation, normal visual fields, and normal speech/language comprehension. MRI shows a 9 mm acute infarct on axial plate B5. Where is the lesion located, and which arteries supply this territory?
q.uz: Gipertoniyasi bo'lgan 61 yoshli ayolda to'satdan o'ng tomonda yuzning pastki yarmi, qo'l va oyoqning bir xil darajadagi falaji rivojlandi; ammo teginish, tebranish, og'riq va harorat sezgisi, ko'rish maydoni hamda nutq tushunishi mutlaqo normal. Aksial B5 kesimidagi MRTda 9 mm o'tkir infarkt o'chog'i aniqlandi. O'choq qayerda joylashgan va bu sohani qaysi arteriyalar ta'minlaydi?

options.en: Left internal capsule posterior limb — pure motor lacunar stroke (lenticulostriate or anterior choroidal arteries)
options.uz: Chap ichki kapsula orqa oyog'i — sof harakat lakunar insulti (lentikulostriar yoki oldingi xorioidal arteriya)

options.en: Left VPL and VPM thalamic nuclei — pure sensory lacunar stroke (thalamogeniculate branches of posterior cerebral artery)
options.uz: Chap talamus VPL va VPM yadrolari — sof sezgi lakunar insulti (orqa miya arteriyasining talamogenikulyar shoxlari)

options.en: Left caudate head and anterior capsule limb — abulic lacunar stroke (recurrent artery of Heubner from ACA)
options.uz: Chap kaudat boshi va kapsula oldingi oyog'i — abulik lakunar insulti (ACA ning Heubner qaytuvchi arteriyasi)

options.en: Left internal capsule genu and corona radiata — dysarthria-clumsy hand stroke (paramedian basilar perforating branches)
options.uz: Chap ichki kapsula tizzasi va nursimon toj — dizartriya-no'noq qo'l insulti (bazilyar paramedian perforantlar)

why.en: On axial plate B5, a small lacunar infarct in the corticospinal and corticobulbar portion of the left posterior limb of the internal capsule (supplied by lateral lenticulostriate or anterior choroidal arteries) produces equal contralateral (right) face, arm, and leg weakness without sensory, visual, or cortical deficits — Fisher's 'pure motor hemiparesis', the commonest lacunar syndrome.
why.uz: B5 aksial plastinkasida chap ichki kapsula orqa oyog'ining harakat qismidagi kichik lakunar infarkt (lateral lentikulostriar yoki oldingi xorioidal arteriya) sezgi, ko'rish va kognitiv belgilarsiz o'ng yuz, qo'l va oyoqning teng gemiparezini — eng ko'p uchraydigan 'sof harakat lakunasi'ni beradi.

q.en: A 68-year-old man presents with the acute triad of right hemiparesis, right hemisensory loss, and a right homonymous hemianopia, but without aphasia, neglect, or gaze deviation. Coronal and axial MRI (plates B3 and B5) reveal an ischaemic infarct encompassing the medial/posteroventral globus pallidus internus (GPi), the ventral/retrolenticular posterior limb of the left internal capsule, and the left optic tract / lateral geniculate body. Which single artery was occluded?
q.uz: 68 yoshli bemorda afaziya va e'tiborsizlik (neglekt) bo'lmagan holda o'tkir triada: o'ng tomonlama gemiparez, o'ng tomonlama gemigipesteziya va o'ng gomonim gemianopiya rivojlandi. MRTda (B3 va B5 plastinkalari) chap ichki rangpar shar (GPi), chap ichki kapsula orqa oyog'ining pastki/retrolentikulyar qismi hamda chap ko'rish trakti / LGN sohasida ishemik infarkt aniqlandi. Qaysi bitta arteriya tiqilib qolgan?

options.en: Left anterior choroidal artery (branch of internal carotid artery)
options.uz: Chap oldingi xorioidal arteriya (ichki uyqu arteriyasi shoxi)

options.en: Left recurrent artery of Heubner (branch of anterior cerebral artery)
options.uz: Chap Heubner qaytuvchi arteriyasi (oldingi miya arteriyasi shoxi)

options.en: Artery of Percheron (paramedian branch of P1 posterior cerebral artery)
options.uz: Percheron arteriyasi (orqa miya arteriyasi P1 paramedian shoxi)

options.en: Left lateral lenticulostriate arteries (M1 middle cerebral artery)
options.uz: Chap lateral lentikulostriar arteriyalar (o'rta miya arteriyasi M1)

why.en: On plates B3 and B5, the anterior choroidal artery (arising from the supraclinoid internal carotid artery) supplies the globus pallidus internus (GPi), the ventral and retrolenticular posterior limb of the internal capsule, the optic tract and LGN, the uncus/amygdala, and the temporal horn choroid plexus. Its occlusion produces the classic Monakow triad of contralateral hemiplegia, hemianaesthesia, and homonymous hemianopia with spared cortical language function.
why.uz: B3 va B5 plastinkalarida ko'rinib turganidek, oldingi xorioidal arteriya (ichki uyqu arteriyasi shoxi) ichki rangpar sharni (GPi), ichki kapsula orqa oyog'ining pastki va retrolentikulyar qismini hamda ko'rish trakti / LGN ni ta'minlaydi. Uning tiqilishi po'stloq belgilari (afaziya) bo'lmagan holda klassik triadani: qarama-qarshi gemiparez, gemigipesteziya va gomonim gemianopiyani beradi.

q.en: In Alexander, DeLong, and Strick's (1986) model of parallel, functionally segregated cortico–basal ganglia–thalamo–cortical loops, how do the (1) sensorimotor, (2) associative/cognitive, and (3) limbic/motivational loops segregate across the striatum, pallidum/SNr, STN, and thalamic relay nuclei (plates B1–B5)?
q.uz: Alexander, DeLong va Strick (1986) modeliga ko'ra, parallel (1) sensomotor, (2) assotsiativ/kognitiv va (3) limbik/motivatsion halqalar striatum, pallidum/SNr, STN va talamus yadrolari bo'ylab qanday taqsimlangan (B1–B5 plastinkalari)?

options.en: (1) Putamen → posteroventral GPi/dorsolateral STN → VLa; (2) Caudate → dorsomedial GPi/ventromedial STN → VA/MD; (3) Accumbens → VP/medial STN → MD

why.en: Alexander, DeLong & Strick (1986) established that parallel functional channels stay segregated through every stage of the basal ganglia: the sensorimotor loop passes through the dorsolateral putamen, dorsolateral STN, posteroventral GPi, and VLa thalamus; the associative loop through the caudate head, ventromedial STN, and VA/MD thalamus; and the limbic loop (Haber & Knutson 2010) through the nucleus accumbens (core/shell), medial-tip STN, ventral pallidum, and MD thalamus (targeted via the ventral anterior limb of the internal capsule in OCD).
why.uz: Alexander, DeLong va Strick (1986) bazal yadrolarda parallel halqalar har bir bosqichda alohida saqlanishini ko'rsatdi: sensomotor halqa — dorsolateral putamen, dorsolateral STN, posteroventral GPi va VLa talamus orqali; assotsiativ halqa — kaudat boshi, ventromedial STN va VA/MD talamus orqali; limbik halqa esa — accumbens yadrosi, STNning medial uchi, ventral pallidum va MD talamus (OKBda ichki kapsula ventral oldingi oyog'i VC/VS DBS nishoni) orqali o'tadi.
